name: Shadow Bride
tactics: A shadow bride is a scrappy fighter and doesn’t mind getting her hands dirty. In fact, she prefers it. She unleashes her built-up rage for those noble snakes who condescend to her upon any who dare assault her. She reserves her psychic punishments for beautifully dressed or well-spoken adversaries.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Rod Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magic implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one or two creatures in the burst marked by the shadow bride

hit.description: psychic damage, and the bride pulls the target 4 squares and knocks it prone.

effect.description: A creature adjacent to the bride is marked. The marked creature grants combat advantage until the end of the bride’s next turn.

powers.name: Nibenay's Retribution
powers.trigger: A enemy marked by the bride and within 6 squares of her makes an attack that does not include the bride as a target.

effect.description: The bride teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering enemy.
